In 2005 Retro Toy Quest founder Wayne Scheiner met his then-future wife, who eventually introduced him to her father. His future father-in-law Robert Gannon had been in the toy business nearly all of his professional career and was nearing retirement. Robert Gannon began his career in 1958 as a toy buyer for some of the most popular retailers through the ’60s and early ’70s.
